title: Common
description: Shared definitions used by the other schemas.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract version (SemVer). Any change that breaks existing readers needs a major bump.

UtcTimestamp.description: UTC instant, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix, up to microsecond precision.

Source.description: Instrument that observed the flash. The order is the index used in binary chunks.

QualityFlag.description: Quality caveat on a flash. The order is the bit index used in binary chunks.

EnergyUnit.description: Unit of energy_raw: J for GLM flash_energy, mW m-2 sr-1 for MTG LI flash radiance.

SourceState.description: Health of a source in the live feed.
